methods.name: Early quests, then copper and tin
methods.note: Doric's Quest, The Dig Site, Plague City and three more give 27,525 XP, level 1 to 37. Otherwise mine copper or tin to 15.

methods.name: Iron ore powermining
methods.note: Stand in a three-rock triangle and drop the ore. From 60 use the Mining Guild, where rocks respawn twice as fast.

methods.name: Motherlode Mine
methods.note: Mine pay-dirt, wash it and bank the ore. Low effort, profitable, and the source of the prospector kit. Rate assumes all upgrades.

methods.name: Sandstone
methods.note: Ironmen mine sandstone and trade it in for buckets of sand, which feeds Crafting training.

methods.name: Gem rocks
methods.note: Underground Shilo Village mine with a charged glory and a gem bag. Ironmen come for opals, jades and red topaz. Best rock golem odds.

methods.name: Calcified rocks
methods.note: Cam Torum mine, only needs Perilous Moons started. Low effort and yields blessed bone shards for Prayer XP.

methods.name: Granite (3-tick)
methods.note: Tick-perfect 3-tick cycle at the desert quarry or Cape Conch. Fastest Mining XP in the game but very click-intensive. About 63,000 without it.

methods.name: Rubium rocks
methods.note: Charred Dungeon on Charred Island, past red and black dragons, so bring antifire. Splinters stack, no banking. Low effort profit.

methods.name: Crashed stars
methods.note: Find a crashed star and mine it, one click every seven minutes. Stardust buys the celestial ring. Lower star tiers work from level 10.

methods.name: Lead rocks
methods.note: Deepfin Mine. Superior or expert mining gloves stop the rocks depleting, so you powermine nonstop with no tick manipulation.

methods.name: Volcanic Mine
methods.note: Fossil Island team minigame, best with 3 to 5 players. Bring food and numulite. Fast XP with no tick manipulation. Dragon pickaxe rates.

methods.name: Zalcano
methods.note: Skilling boss under Prifddinas. Toggle resource rewards off at Rhiannon for more XP. Rates swing with team size and kills per hour.

methods.name: Blast Mine
methods.note: Solo minigame using dynamite, a chisel and a tinderbox, plus stamina. Profitable and fast from 75, when runite starts to drop.

methods.name: Amethyst
methods.note: Mining Guild amethyst crystals, 80 to 100 an hour. Very low effort and steady profit, but slow. Expert mining gloves help.

unverified: Early quests, then copper and tin: no hourly rate is given for copper or tin, and quest XP is a one-off
Motherlode Mine: the only rate is about 62,000 at level 90 with every upgrade and a dragon pickaxe; the page's post-99 table says 54,000 to 60,000; nothing below 90
Sandstone: the Ironman Guide gives no rate
Calcified rocks: no rate below level 50, so the level 50 rate is used from 41; needs Perilous Moons started, not completed
Lead rocks: the page only says up to 90,000 to 100,000 with mining enhancers; 81,000 is 85% of the midpoint and there is no rate by level
Crashed stars: dragon pickaxe column without prospector kit; a dragon pickaxe needs 61, the rune pickaxe figure at 60 is 23,500
Zalcano: the section says no representative rate exists; 71,000 at 99 is the midpoint of the post-99 table's 50,000 to 92,000 for XP mode
Volcanic Mine: accessible at 50; main guide recommends it from 70, the Ironman Guide calls it viable from 85
Blast Mine: dynamite supply for ironmen is not described in either guide
Granite: desert heat protection or partial Troubled Tortugans (Cape Conch) is needed but cannot be expressed in req
